items.title: Show HN: GBFC – AOT and JIT Compiler Brainfuck and Brainfuck++
items.contentSnippet:
GBFC stands for General BrainFuck Compiler.
In the compiler, I implemented 7 optimizations and many small optimizations outside the optimizer module, which allows the Mandelbrot set to be rendered in 0.9–1.1 seconds (about twice as slow as Rust, but remember, this is BrainFuck). You can see other benchmarks in the Github repo (README) and run them yourself.

items.title: Show HN: BScaff - A CLI tool for project scaffolding and snippets
items.contentSnippet:
I built BScaff, a CLI tool for saving and reusing project structures, templates, files, and text snippets. It can serve as a URL bookmark tool as well.
It started with project scaffolding, but I wanted something more general-purpose: a tool that could save almost any reusable starting point and bring it back whenever needed. items.title: Show HN: Merlin, Run Your Claude Code and Codex from Slack, Linear and GitHub
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN, I built Merlin to let you use your own Claude Code and Codex subscription from Slack, Linear, and GitHub.
There is a desktop app for macOS and Windows, and a CLI daemon for Linux. When someone mentions Merlin in a Slack thread or Linear issue comment, the task runs on that team member's machine, using their own Claude Code or Codex runtime, and progress and results come back to the original thread.
